lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

steps: Open Underlay storage directly from Settings next to Project, return to Settings and verify General has no duplicate entry; open the catalog picker from Add layer. Both AppCompat screens load with their title and Back button.
On Android 16 inspect a populated catalog and its action dialog; the first row is entirely below the toolbar and above system navigation, including after returning to the screen.

Reuse one archive SHA across a legacy NGRc tree and a converted MBTiles asset; verify rendering, project zoom limits and presentation after migration, interrupted redirect and cold load of an older mismatched reference.
Import NGRc with OSM and TMS coordinates; compare the geographic tile position and visibility padding.

Import an unmodified standard archive with Mapnik.json and Mapnik/z/x/y.jpg; compare all tile bytes and repeat without duplication. Reject a missing/ambiguous config with a live map and verify worker cleanup does not crash MapLibre.
Verify one MBTiles payload and no extracted tree; repeat import in the same and another project without payload growth.
Import raster MBTiles and ZIP containing one MBTiles; reject vector data and ordinary ZIP-TMS in the dedicated picker.

Open local with the same NGRc or raster MBTiles fixture as New underlay from file; the fill dialog shows the file name rather than a SAF id such as msf:308, and the progress bar advances; the asset appears in Underlay storage and can be attached to another project.
Remove a project layer, undo, delete a project and reset settings; verify shared payload remains.
Delete in catalog after confirming all project names; reopen nested closed projects and verify only matching links disappeared.

On Geonical with trusted Debug installed, Underlay storage shows Import from the old app; the layer picker and Project settings do not. Without an active project the action reports that there is no project and does not start Debug export.
Interrupt legacy move and new import at checkpoints, restart and verify original data, style and layer order.
value.expected: Shared assets preserve data across project lifecycle; only confirmed global removal deletes payload; hot-add renders without restart.
